findings.title: Unnecessary wildcard case in match statement
findings.body: The wildcard case `_` returns `False`, which is the same as the default behaviour of the original `return status in RETRYABLE_STATES and retries_used < retry_limit`. The explicit case adds no value and reduces readability.

summary.problem: The match statement introduces an unnecessary wildcard case that does not improve clarity.
summary.done_well: The refactor uses a match statement to explicitly list retryable states, improving readability for the happy path.
